message: PostgreSQL connection failed; orders-api health returned database unavailable and HTTP 503.

analysis.probable_root_cause: The PostgreSQL service container had stopped, so orders-api could not open database connections.

health.details: PostgreSQL became Docker-healthy and orders-api returned HTTP 200 with database=healthy.

remediation.resolution_summary: After operator approval, the existing stopped PostgreSQL container was started without recreating it or changing its volume.

message: Report jobs repeatedly terminated with an out-of-memory container event during large exports.

analysis.probable_root_cause: A newly enabled export path retained complete result sets in memory and exceeded the worker memory limit.

health.details: A bounded export completed and memory remained below the verified operating threshold.

remediation.resolution_summary: The export was changed to stream bounded batches after review, then the worker was restarted and monitored.

message: Checkout requests failed because the service could not resolve the inventory-api hostname.

analysis.probable_root_cause: A deployment referenced an obsolete internal DNS service name for inventory-api.

health.details: DNS resolution, inventory connectivity, and checkout synthetic requests all succeeded.

remediation.resolution_summary: The reviewed deployment configuration was rolled back to the last known valid inventory service name.

message: Image uploads failed with object storage access denied responses.

analysis.probable_root_cause: A rotated workload identity was missing the object-write permission for the upload bucket.

health.details: A synthetic image upload and read-back succeeded with the reviewed least-privilege policy.

remediation.resolution_summary: The missing bucket write permission was added to the reviewed workload policy and verified with a synthetic upload.

message: Search index requests failed during a recovery attempt.

analysis.probable_root_cause: The recovery attempt did not restore service health.
